zh.title: 國防部偵獲3架次共機越中線 國軍運用機艦與飛彈監控
zh.summary: 國防部偵獲共機4架次與共艦6艘，其中3架次共機逾越海峽中線進入北部空域。
body: 台灣國防部於8月31日上午公布最新共機艦動態，統計自8月30日上午6時起至8月31日上午6時止，共計偵獲中國軍機4架次、軍艦6艘及公務船4艘在台灣周邊海空域活動。
根據國防部說明，在偵獲的4架次中國軍機中，有3架次逾越台灣海峽中線，侵擾台灣北部空域。國軍對此全程掌握，並運用任務機、艦及岸置飛彈系統進行嚴密監控與應處。
另據本站統計紀錄顯示，前一日即8月30日的統計數據為共機3架次、共艦8艘與公務船5艘。國軍持續維持戒備，確保周邊海空域安全。

en.title: Taiwan Detects 4 PLA Aircraft and 6 Naval Vessels Near Airspace
en.summary: Taiwan detected four PLA aircraft and six naval vessels, with three aircraft crossing the Strait median line.
body: Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense reported that four Chinese military aircraft, six naval vessels, and four official ships were detected operating around Taiwan between 06:00 on August 30 and 06:00 on August 31, 2026.

According to the defense ministry, three of the detected PLA aircraft sorties crossed the median line of the Taiwan Strait and entered northern airspace. In response, Taiwan's armed forces deployed combat aircraft, naval vessels, and land-based missile systems to closely monitor and respond to the activity.
According to site statistics recorded by AVWIRE, the figures from the previous report on August 30 showed three PLA aircraft, eight naval vessels, and five official ships operating in the area.
